# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

## **High‑Performance Gas Filtration with Lower CAPEX**

 

Pall’s High Flow Gas solution delivers reliable particulate removal for large‑volume gas streams
while helping operators lower upfront CAPEX. Smaller vessels and fewer elements reduce footprint and
maintenance demands while protecting downstream equipment and supporting long‑term performance.

 

[
Learn More High‑Performance Gas Filtration

## **Revolutionizing Filtration for the Food & Beverage Industry**

 

Membralox® GP-IC ceramic membrane systems deliver cleaner, more efficient processing with less waste
and downtime. Designed for demanding applications, they help manufacturers transform premium
ingredients and alternative protein production while reducing footprint and cost.

 

[
Learn More Membralox GP-IC
][54]

## **Supralon^{®} Replacement Oil Filter Elements**

 

With high efficiency and consistent performance, our Supralon Filter Elements enable customers to
rapidly achieve and maintain required cleanliness levels that protect lube and hydraulic systems
against component failure and unscheduled downtime that can cost tens of thousands of dollars per
hour.

What We Do

## Comprehensive Systems Integration

From architecture and deployment to ongoing optimization, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions
that align with your business objectives.

🖥

### Computer Systems Design

Custom infrastructure blueprints engineered for performance, redundancy, and cost efficiency. We
assess your workloads and architect systems that scale with your business.

🌐

### Network Architecture

Secure, high-throughput network designs spanning LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, and wireless. Every topology is
documented, tested, and optimized for zero-downtime operation.

☁

### Cloud Migration & Hybrid

Seamless transitions to AWS, Azure, or private cloud environments. We handle workload assessment,
data migration, and post-migration validation with minimal disruption.

🛡

### Cybersecurity Hardening

Multi-layered defense strategies including endpoint protection, intrusion detection, SIEM
integration, and compliance-ready audit trails for regulated industries.

📈

### Managed IT Operations

24/7 monitoring, patch management, backup orchestration, and help desk escalation. Proactive
maintenance that prevents outages before they impact your users.

🔧

### System Integration & API

Connecting disparate platforms through custom middleware, RESTful APIs, and message queues. Unified
data flows that eliminate manual reconciliation and siloed reporting.

Who We Serve

## Industries We Power

Specialized expertise across regulated, high-availability, and data-intensive sectors where system
reliability is non-negotiable.

#### Healthcare & Life Sciences

HIPAA-compliant infrastructure, EHR integration, and secure telemedicine platforms designed for
clinical workflows and patient data protection.

#### Financial Services & Fintech

Low-latency trading infrastructure, PCI-DSS compliant payment systems, and SOC 2-ready architectures
for banking, insurance, and investment platforms.

#### Logistics & Supply Chain

Real-time inventory tracking, warehouse management system integration, and route optimization
engines that reduce operating costs and improve delivery SLAs.

#### Professional Services

Document management systems, CRM deployments, and unified communications platforms for legal,
accounting, and consulting firms with demanding confidentiality requirements.

#### Manufacturing & Industrial

SCADA integration, IoT sensor networks, and predictive maintenance dashboards connecting factory
floors to executive visibility in real time.

#### Retail & E-Commerce

Omnichannel POS integration, inventory synchronization, and CDN-accelerated storefronts engineered
for Black Friday-scale traffic without performance degradation.

About Us

## Engineering Reliability Into Every System

BG HANDYMAN LLC was founded on a single conviction: technology infrastructure should be a growth
accelerator, not a recurring headache. Headquartered in Tampa, Florida, we serve organizations
across the United States that depend on their systems being available, secure, and cost-effective.

Our team combines deep expertise in systems engineering, network design, and cloud architecture with
a practical, outcomes-driven approach. We do not believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. Every
engagement begins with understanding your operational requirements, compliance obligations, and
growth trajectory.

What sets us apart is our integration-first philosophy. Rather than patching together incompatible
tools, we design holistic ecosystems where your hardware, software, and cloud services operate as a
unified platform, reducing complexity and lowering total cost of ownership.

## What makes Elos Medtech unique?

We empower medical device companies with expert support across product R&D, manufacturing solutions,
and a full suite of value-added services—helping them enhance their product offerings while
streamlining operations and reducing complexity.

With a commitment to long-term partnerships, our specialized business units bring deep industry
expertise, while seamless cross-unit collaboration ensures access to the latest technologies—even
those new to a particular field.

Together, we deliver tailored solutions that spark innovation, minimize risk, and drive
growth—redefining medical device innovation to enhance lives worldwide.

We put our customers at the heart of everything we do.

## INDIVIDUALISED CARE FOR
## EACH AND EVERY PATIENT

In the critical care setting, most patients require intravenous drugs and vital fluids during their
stay, making this therapeutic area important in helping to save and sustain lives. From the
emergency room, to the intensive care unit, to the operating room, no two patients’ therapeutic
needs look the same. How does a healthcare company address a hospital’s breadth of requirements for
this high-demand and essential treatment area, while also supporting individualised patient care?

[Healthcare professional assisting a patient in a hospital bed]

### BAXTER'S PRODUCT ECOSYSTEM CAN HELP TO MEET YOUR NEEDS

Baxter's end-to-end product ecosystem supports healthcare providers at multiple touchpoints from the
pharmacy to the bedside and beyond, enabling them to personalise therapy and helping them to forge a
pathway to recovery across the care continuum.

Whether used separately or in tandem, Baxter's products may support you in advancing patient care.

To learn more, select a product category.

An advanced clinical surveillance software suite that uses data integration to produce actionable
insights relevant to disease surveillance, antimicrobial stewardship, and the management of
catastrophic disease outbreaks and mass vaccination programs.

[View Digital Health][34]

An accurate,¹ non-invasive, central-flow-based approach to fluid management monitoring, enabling
clinicians to confidently respond to ever-changing patient physiology and deliver personalised care.

[View Advanced Patient Monitoring][35]

Tools designed to help pharmacy staff improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.

[View Pharmacy Tools][36]

Easy-to-use elastomeric ambulatory infusion systems that give clinicians and their patients
treatment options both inside and outside the hospital environment.

[View Ambulatory Infusion Systems][37]

Vital intravenous solutions that deliver essential electrolytes and medications to support
life-saving treatments, as well as solutions for irrigation.

[View Intravenous & Irrigation Solutions][38]

## NEWS & EVENTS

### Registration For Sepsis eCourse Is Open!

In partnership with the European Society of Emergency Medicine (EUSEM), register to attend a free
course on the Emergency and prehospital phases of sepsis.

## PRODUCTS

Huayan produces vision inspection systems for infusion liquid in glass&plastic bottles, IV bags,
ampoules, oral liquid, PET preforms, cap, bottled water, alcohol in the pharmaceutical,
food&beverage and other industries. 
* [ [Pharmaceutical Infusion Bottle Vision Inspection Solution] ][36]
  [Automatic Large Volume Parenteral Inspection System for Plastic Bottles][37]
  The Pharmaceutical Bottles Vision Inspection System is designed to automate the inspection process
  in pharmaceutical manufacturing. Leveraging high-speed cameras and AI-driven image recognition,
  the inspection system identifies various defects when process different bottle types and offers
  real-time monitoring for enhanced quality control.
* [ [Pharmaceutical Glass Bottle Inspection System] ][38]
  [Automatic Inspection System for Large Volume Parenteral in Glass Bottles][39]
  The large-volume infusion drugs inspection machine can be applied to various pharmaceutical
  products, including large-capacity infusion liquid in glass bottles. This inspection equipment
  primarily detects small defects, visible foreign object and appearance defects in the glass
  bottles. The detection principle involves visual imaging, utilizing AI models to identify defects
  present in the products, and classifying and rejecting defective products.
* [ [Pharma Automatic Inspection Solution] ][40]
  [Automatic Pharmaceutical IV Bag Vision Inspection Machine][41]
  The Automatic IV Bag Vision Inspection Machine is designed for large infusion products contained
  in soft bags. Utilizing an advanced imaging contrast processing system, it effectively identifies
  both qualified and defective products. Defective items are automatically removed through a
  built-in mechanism, ensuring high-quality standards and efficient production of infusion
  products.WhatsApp & Tel: +86 18122705268
* [ [OEM Preform Inspection System] ][42]
  [Automatic High-Precision Preform Inspection System][43]
  The PET Preform Automatic Light Inspection Machine is an intelligent visual inspection equipment
  independently developed by HUAYAN. This advance equipment is designed to detect various appearance
  defects of PET preforms including preform neck, sealing mouth gaps, flash, black spots, shrinkage,
  stringing and bubbles, etc. The detection function is modular and can be configured according to
  customer needs. Suitable for online and offline inspection of preforms with various
  specifications.
* [ [Closure Vision System] ][44]
  [Automatic High-Speed Closure Vision Inspection Machine][45]
  This Cap Vision Inspection Machine is a fully automated inspection equipment based on machine
  vision technology, specifically designed for detecting defects in caps. It uses high-speed,
  high-precision cameras and advanced image processing algorithms to quickly and accurately identify
  and locate various defects on the front and back, inside, and sides of bottle caps, such as black
  spots, dirt, burrs, and deformations.
* [ [Five-Gallon Water Bottles Vision Inspection Solution] ][46]
  [Automated High-Resolution Visual Inspection for Five-Gallon Water Bottles][47]
  Automatic Five-Gallon Water Bottles Visual Inspection System to ensure the quality and integrity
  in large water bottles by streamlining the inspection process, improving efficiency while
  minimizing human error. Its high-resolution capabilities allow for the detection of even the
  smallest imperfections, ensuring that five-gallon water bottle meets industry standards for safety
  and reliability.

Welcome to Flagship

FLAGSHIP BIOTECH INTERNATIONAL PVT. LTD. is fully integrated Pharmaceutical company with an
established presence across the globe in more than 45 countries.

The company is headquartered in India - Mumbai.

We are the fastest growing Indian pharmaceutical company engaged into Manufacturing and Marketing a
broad range of pharmaceutical preparations globally.

We believe that our competitive advantage in the International Market lies in our established
presence in all major therapeutic areas including Oncology, Anti-Diabetic, Cardiology, Pain and
Analgesics, Gynecology, Anti-infectives, Vitamins, Minerals, Nutrients, Gastro-Intestinal,
Anti-Osteoporosis, Anti-Malarial, Immunosuppressant, Anti-Bacterial, Anti- Asthmatics, Anti-Allergy
etc.

We provide affordable and quality medicines across the world, regardless of Geographic and Socio
Economic barriers.

Flagship Biotech International has set benchmarks for Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and achieved a
Marketing Excellence in the Branded Generics- Ethical, API, Formulations, OTC & Institutional
segments globally and has emerged as a respectable name in the Global Pharmaceutical and Healthcare
Arena.

[api]

Manufacturing

Flagship Biotech International provides the advanced manufacturing capabilities and processes that
create special quality of Generic Products.

The reputation of our company is built on Manufacturing and R&D facilities that are designed to meet
Global Standards, and Stringent Quality standards that ensure we deliver only the best formulations
and products.

Our state of the Art Manufacturing Facilities maintaining high Quality Standards at every further
stage and Manufacturing process are located in Tarapur near Mumbai (Maharashtra, India) Navsari,
Naroda (Gujrat, India), Baddi (Himachal Pradesh, India)

Manufacturing facilities with the quality standards of global regulatory authorities including the
WHO – GMP, US FDA, MCC, PICS HEALTH CANADA and various other approvals.

It has capability to manufacture high quality Solid & Liquid Dosage Form, LVP, SVP, Speciality
Injectables, Powder for Injections, Inhalers, Ointments and Creams etc.

We have cost leadership with large scale, complex products.

The company endeavors to Manufacturing rich array of Quality Formulation supported by its strong
Formulation & Development department and State-of-Art Manufacturing facilities for its own market
and for several reputed organizations in India and Abroad. The company is committed to implement
Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) in its pursuit of continues
business growth.

## Get To Know Us

[Mohawk Industries Headquarters]

### Who Are We?

Mohawk is the world’s largest flooring company and so much more. With leading market positions on
four continents, Mohawk offers a comprehensive array of fashionable, high performance and
sustainable flooring options for residential and commercial spaces as well as a growing selection of
products for surfaces beyond the floor.

[Learn More][120]
[Ceramic Tile Floor]

### Ceramic Tile

As the world’s largest ceramic tile provider, Mohawk combines the finest Italian design with
state-of-the-art manufacturing technology.

[Learn More][121]
[Residential Carpet]

### Residential Carpet

Mohawk’s award-winning carpets add warmth and style to any home while offering luxurious softness
and superior stain protection.

[Learn More][122]
[Commercial Flooring]

### Commercial Flooring

Mohawk combines innovative design and exceptional performance in a variety of soft and hard surface
options for every commercial space.

[Learn More][123]
[Area Rug]

### Area Rugs, Bath Rugs & Mats

As the world’s largest rug manufacturer, Mohawk creates elegant home fashion crafted with super soft
and stain-resistant fibers.

## Get To Know Us

[Mohawk Industries Headquarters]

### Who Are We?

Mohawk is the world’s largest flooring company and so much more. With leading market positions on
four continents, Mohawk offers a comprehensive array of fashionable, high performance and
sustainable flooring options for residential and commercial spaces as well as a growing selection of
products for surfaces beyond the floor.

[Learn More][120]
[Ceramic Tile Floor]

### Ceramic Tile

As the world’s largest ceramic tile provider, Mohawk combines the finest Italian design with
state-of-the-art manufacturing technology.

[Learn More][121]
[Residential Carpet]

### Residential Carpet

Mohawk’s award-winning carpets add warmth and style to any home while offering luxurious softness
and superior stain protection.

[Learn More][122]
[Commercial Flooring]

### Commercial Flooring

Mohawk combines innovative design and exceptional performance in a variety of soft and hard surface
options for every commercial space.

[Learn More][123]

### Area Rugs, Bath Rugs & Mats

As the world’s largest rug manufacturer, Mohawk creates elegant home fashion crafted with super soft
and stain-resistant fibers.

[Learn More][124]
[Laminate Floor]

### Laminate

With realistic surface visuals and textures and a unique water proof construction, Mohawk’s laminate
flooring outperforms even Mother Nature.

[Learn More][125]
[Luxury Vinyl Tile Floor]

### Luxury Vinyl Tile

In both rigid and flexible LVT, Mohawk offers exceptional visuals that replicate wood, stone and
porcelain while delivering outstanding performance and water resistance.

[Learn More][126]
[Sheet Vinyl Floor]

### Sheet Vinyl

Mohawk is an international leader in sheet vinyl, with advanced technology and superior design that
produces realistic visuals, deeper textures and bolder colors.

[Learn More][127]
[Wood Floor]

### Wood

Mohawk pioneered waterproof wood flooring and offers beautiful contemporary visuals in popular
longer and wider planks.

[Learn More][128]
[Bathroom Countertop]

### Countertops

An extensive assortment of quartz, porcelain and natural stone options in countertops and slabs
provides beautiful, durable and versatile surfaces for homes and commercial spaces.

[Learn More][129]
[Panels]

### Panels

A broad range of chipboard, MDF, melamine-faced, HPL panels and mezzanine flooring solutions for
construction, interior design, furniture, cabinetry and other residential and commercial
applications.

[Learn More][130]
[Insulation]

### Insulation

A wide variety of high thermal performance PIR insulation products for residential and commercial
new construction and renovation projects available for wall, roof, attic and floor installation.

### Why Double Euro Cap Technology Is the Best

The Double Euro Cap represents a significant advancement in infusion bottle closure technology,

##### 01. Enhanced Patient Safety

The dual-port design allows drug admixture and IV access through separate ports, minimizing the risk
of contamination and medication errors. This controlled access improves safety during preparation
and administration.

##### 02.Superior Sterility Assurance

Each port is individually sealed, reducing repeated punctures on a single access point. This design
helps maintain container closure integrity, ensuring sterility throughout the product’s lifecycle.

##### 03.Improved Clinical Convenience

Healthcare professionals can add medications without interrupting the infusion line. This saves
time, reduces handling, and supports smoother clinical workflows.

##### 04. Reduced Infection Risk

By separating infusion and additive functions, the Double Euro Cap significantly lowers the risk of
microbial ingress compared to conventional single-port closures.

Your Health is Our Top Goal

The healthcare system in Africa continues to face significant challenges, including limited access
to quality medicines, supply chain constraints, high dependency on imports, and the need for
reliable, affordable essential healthcare products. These gaps directly affect patient outcomes and
strain already overburdened healthcare systems.

### Why Double Euro Cap Technology Is the Best

The Double Euro Cap represents a significant advancement in infusion bottle closure technology,

##### 01. Enhanced Patient Safety

The dual-port design allows drug admixture and IV access through separate ports, minimizing the risk
of contamination and medication errors. This controlled access improves safety during preparation
and administration.

##### 02.Superior Sterility Assurance

Each port is individually sealed, reducing repeated punctures on a single access point. This design
helps maintain container closure integrity, ensuring sterility throughout the product’s lifecycle.

##### 03.Improved Clinical Convenience

Healthcare professionals can add medications without interrupting the infusion line. This saves
time, reduces handling, and supports smoother clinical workflows.

##### 04. Reduced Infection Risk

By separating infusion and additive functions, the Double Euro Cap significantly lowers the risk of
microbial ingress compared to conventional single-port closures.

Your Health is Our Top Goal

They are also known as rubber bungs, and rubber stoppers which are used to seal bottles, tubes, and
many other containers. They plug containers from the outside without displacing the volume inside.
Some more resistant stoppers can also be used for heavy industrial processes.

What is a rubber stopper used for?

Rubber stoppers are used to seal bottles, tubes and other containers so that their contents do not
spill outside the container. At the same time they ensure that the outside air or atmosphere does
not contaminate the contents of the container.

What rubber is used in pharmaceutical packaging?

The most widely used rubber in pharmaceutical packaging are butyl, Bromobutyl, and Chlorobutyl
rubbers. Nitrile and neoprene rubbers are used for applications where oil resistance and high
temperature resistance is required. Natural rubber is sometimes used for multidose injections.
Silicon rubbers which have a high degree of inertness are mainly used for Opthalmic and contact lens
solution applications.

What is the role of rubber closures in pharmaceutical packaging?

The primary role of rubber closure in pharmaceutical packaging is to provide an inert barrier
between the contents of the vial and the outside ambient atmosphere. The closure has to be inert so
that it does not react with the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient or the preservative. It should also
not leach out any particles inside the vial and contaminate it during the entire period of storage.
It is also important that it does not allow water vapour and other gases present in the outside air
to enter the vial ,thereby maintaining the potency and efficacy of the medication . It should not
shed any particles when the injectable needle penetrates it at the time of administration of
injection.

What are rubber bungs made of?

The range of standard rubber bungs includes that made from butyl and Halobutyl rubbers. Besides
these, bungs made of nitrile, neoprene, natural rubber, and silicon rubber are also available as
standard products for specialized applications.

The primary role of rubber closure in pharmaceutical packaging is to provide an inert barrier
between the contents of the vial and the outside ambient atmosphere. The closure has to be inert so
that it does not react with the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient or the preservative. It should also
not leach out any particles inside the vial and contaminate it during the entire period of storage.
It is also important that it does not allow water vapour and other gases present in the outside air
to enter the vial ,thereby maintaining the potency and efficacy of the medication . It should not
shed any particles when the injectable needle penetrates it at the time of administration of
injection.

What are rubber bungs made of?

The range of standard rubber bungs includes that made from butyl and Halobutyl rubbers. Besides
these, bungs made of nitrile, neoprene, natural rubber, and silicon rubber are also available as
standard products for specialized applications.

## Welcome to Vision Parenteral

Vision Parenteral Private Limited incorporated in the year 2011, was established with the objective
to manufacture High Quality Healthcare Products using the Latest "State-of-The-Art" FFS (Form, Fill,
Seal) & BFS (Blow, Fill, Seal) Technologies from Weiler Engg. USA and Glass Bottles Technology from
Pharma Lab.

The Plant is equipped with the advanced facility as per the USFDA & EUGMP guidelines for
manufacturing Sterile Large Volume Parenteral, Lifesaving medicines & Hospital Consumables.

Intravenous Fluids in Purely Polyethylene containers, granules procured from LG Korea & Loyendell
Basel USA only and glass bottles from HNG Glass.

I.V. Fluid and sealed in closed circuit in most aseptic condition.

## Welcome to Vision Parenteral

Vision Parenteral Private Limited incorporated in the year 2011, was established with the objective
to manufacture High Quality Healthcare Products using the Latest "State-of-The-Art" FFS (Form, Fill,
Seal) & BFS (Blow, Fill, Seal) Technologies from Weiler Engg. USA and Glass Bottles Technology from
Pharma Lab.

The Plant is equipped with the advanced facility as per the USFDA & EUGMP guidelines for
manufacturing Sterile Large Volume Parenteral, Lifesaving medicines & Hospital Consumables.

Vision has the first of its kind of LVP plant in Uttar Pradesh, India. The company manufactures
Intravenous Fluids in Purely Polyethylene containers, granules procured from LG Korea & Loyendell
Basel USA only and glass bottles from HNG Glass.

## 18,000m² of production Bases

Our purpose-built, company-owned manufacturing site located in the advanced technology development
city, Shanghai, China. VSUN implements international advanced machining technology standards for the
high-end BFS equipment.

[Learn More][27]

## What do we do?

The Blow-Fill-Seal Technique can complete the container formation on a single machine under a
controlled environment that maintain the liquid in an aseptic manner. The open containers only
exposed to the clean room air for less than 1.5 seconds. This technique is highly used in
Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics, Functional Foods & Nutraceuticals, Chemical Engineering Fields and so on…
